description: The project's launches, newest first, as the Suites view of Test Results lists them: tests started together (a suite, a schedule, a selection, a test category) are one launch, a test started on its own is one too. Each has its batch_id (for list_runs, list_conversations and compare_batch), its kind and label, its suite or schedule, when it started and finished, whether it still runs, its tests by outcome, the share of tests without a major problem, its conversations and its major and minor problems, and the run numbers of its tests. Filter by kind, suite, status, mode, a date range (from, to) or a search; page with offset.

from.description: Only what started on or after this moment: a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO date and time, UTC unless it names its offset.
from.title: From

kind.description: Only launches of this kind: suite (a suite run by hand), schedule (started by a schedule), selection (several tests picked together), category (the tests of a test category), single (one test on its own).
kind.title: Kind

limit.description: Most launches to return, newest first.
limit.title: Limit

mode.description: Only tests of this mode: regular, red_team or bias.
mode.title: Mode

offset.description: Skip this many, for the next page.
offset.title: Offset

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

search.description: Only launches whose label or one of whose test names contains this.
search.title: Search

status.description: running while any of its tests works, completed after.
status.title: Status

suite.description: Only the launches of this suite: its id or name, as list_suites shows it.
suite.title: Suite

to.description: Only what started on or before this moment: a date (YYYY-MM-DD, the whole day counts) or an ISO date and time, UTC unless it names its offset.
to.title: To

name: list_batches
